winning_patterns: A dramatic ACTION in the title (lifted a mountain, snatched a life, finished a war in 1 minute)
Lesser-known Mahabharata characters and secrets (Barbareek, Ulupi, Yuyutsu)
avoid: Descriptive relation titles like 'X — Y ke pita! 🔱' (Surya 1 view, Nandi 8, Vayu 14)
Mixing Marathi/Gujarati/English full episodes on the same Hindi channel
Off-niche uploads (the 'Trending Effects' clouds video got views but brings the wrong audience)
